moderate_claims.claim_text: Reddit's data advantage and intellectual property are a key competitive asset, and the Revolving Credit Facility is secured by liens on substantially all assets including intellectual property assets.
moderate_claims.M_check: uspto_odp.query_assignee('Reddit', cutoff 2024-03-21)
moderate_claims.M_value: n_total_applications=2, n_granted (pre-cutoff)=1; only filing is a single provisional/non-provisional pair titled 'Decentralized Social-Media Platform'
moderate_claims.interpretation: USPTO shows an essentially empty patent portfolio at the IPO date. However, Reddit's IP claim is explicitly grounded in its DATA CORPUS and trademarks, not a patent estate — the prospectus never asserts a large patent count, so this is NOT the Nikola pattern (CALIBRATION heuristic 7). The thin patent count is a mild gap between the marketed 'intellectual property' framing and registry-recordable IP, but is fully consistent with a content platform whose moat is data, not patents. Scored MODERATE (ceiling-vs-implied gap), not SEVERE.

moderate_claims.claim_text: ServiceTitan holds 14 issued U.S. patents (plus 4 issued foreign, 9 U.S. applications) protecting its trades-software technology.
moderate_claims.M_check: uspto_odp.query_assignee(assignee_name='ServiceTitan', cutoff_date='2024-12-12')
moderate_claims.M_value: n_total_applications=29, n_granted=7 pre-cutoff. Granted patents (e.g. 12154146 'Automated Customer Review Matching', granted 2024-11-26; 'Systems and Methods for Dynamic Pricing' Notice of Allowance) are all real trades-SaaS technology in CPC G06Q/G06N classes — coherent with the claimed product area.
moderate_claims.interpretation: Partial corroboration. Genuine granted IP exists and is on-thesis (pricing, scheduling, recommendation, review-matching ML), so this is NOT a Nikola-pattern fabrication. But the USPTO ODP single-token firstApplicantName index surfaces only 7 granted patents vs the 14 issued U.S. patents claimed. The gap is most likely an index-coverage artifact (recent grants, name-variant assignments, foreign/continuation families not captured by the single-token match) rather than inflation, but on the evidence available the registry shows fewer than claimed -> MODERATE rather than PASS.

moderate_claims.claim_text: Microsoft was CoreWeave's largest customer, 62% of 2024 revenue ($1.2B recognized), under a Feb 2023 Microsoft MSA.
moderate_claims.M_check: edgar_fts CoreWeave in Microsoft (CIK 0000789019) filings; megacap_namecheck Microsoft subset
moderate_claims.M_value: Microsoft filings: 0 mentions of CoreWeave (10-K/10-Q/8-K, full history). megacap_namecheck Microsoft total_hits=0.
moderate_claims.interpretation: The buyer (Microsoft) never names CoreWeave in its SEC filings despite CoreWeave booking 62% of its revenue ($1.2B) from Microsoft. No independent registry corroborates the Microsoft relationship directly; scored MODERATE (counterparty-side absence, but with benign explanation and strong internal/financial-statement consistency), not SEVERE.

moderate_claims.claim_text: The Company restated its FY2022/2021/2020 financials to correct misstatements and is highly levered (~EUR 2bn institutional term loan + ~EUR 4bn related-party shareholder loans), with recurring net losses and reliance on a EUR315m RCF.
moderate_claims.M_check: Internal financial-statement disclosure (audited KPMG report + MD&A in the 424B4); going-concern read from prospectus.
moderate_claims.M_value: Auditor (KPMG AB) report explicitly states FY2020-2022 statements were RESTATED to correct misstatements. Recurring net losses: -252.7 (2022), -126.3 (2021), -237.2 (2020); -113.9 nine-mo 2023. Total debt ~EUR 6bn incl. EUR ~4bn related-party shareholder loans (to be equitized/repaid at IPO) + EUR 1.7bn term loan. As of Sep-30-2023 only EUR 4.3M available under the RCF; negative equity for most of the period (deficit -73.9 at YE2022).
moderate_claims.interpretation: These are honestly and prominently DISCLOSED negatives (restatement, leverage, losses), not concealed — consistent with the honesty-alpha framework (disclosed bad news is not a lie). The IPO is structured to deleverage via shareholder-loan equitization and proceeds repayment. Scored MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY to flag the genuine balance-sheet stress and prior-period restatement as a real risk surfaced by the filing, while recognizing full disclosure (no contradiction, no concealment -> not SEVERE/RED).

moderate_claims.claim_text: Tempus's TIME Trial program (launched June 2019) has more than 230 clinical trials signed into the network, with more than 30,000 patients.
moderate_claims.M_check: clinical_trials.query_by_lead_sponsor(Tempus, cutoff 2024-06-17)
moderate_claims.M_value: ClinicalTrials.gov shows Tempus AI as LEAD SPONSOR on only 7 pre-cutoff studies (13 total in registry). The '>230 clinical trials signed into the network' refers to trials Tempus MATCHES patients into / supports operationally (sponsored by pharma/sites), not trials Tempus itself sponsors — so the lead-sponsor count is the wrong denominator and cannot directly confirm 230.
moderate_claims.interpretation: Heuristic: the registry confirms Tempus AI is a genuine, active clinical-trial participant (7 sponsored + AstraZeneca/GSK collaborators), which is consistent with operating a trial-matching network. But the specific '>230 trials in network' is a network-participation metric ClinicalTrials.gov's lead-sponsor view cannot enumerate (those trials are sponsored by third parties). The registry corroborates the activity directionally but cannot confirm the 230 count, so partial corroboration -> MODERATE rather than PASS. No contradiction; the gap is a registry-coverage limitation, not evidence of inflation.

moderate_claims.claim_text: Tempus's offerings have been used by approximately 95% of the largest public pharmaceutical companies based on 2023 revenue.
moderate_claims.M_check: clinical_trials.query_by_lead_sponsor(Tempus) collaborators + edgar_fts(Tempus)
moderate_claims.M_value: ClinicalTrials.gov surfaces AstraZeneca + GlaxoSmithKline as Tempus AI trial collaborators (2 of the largest global pharmas) — direct evidence of multiple top-pharma relationships. EDGAR full-text 'Tempus' = 291 hits across filers but with name-collision noise (a separate 'Tempus Applied Solutions' defense entity). No single registry enumerates 'pharma data-customer penetration %'.
moderate_claims.interpretation: The registry confirms at least two top-tier pharma customers/collaborators (AZ, GSK), so the claim's direction is corroborated, but '~95% of the largest public pharma companies' is a marketing-penetration metric no federal registry can verify or refute (pharma B2B data licenses are not separately disclosed; heuristic 5/8). Partial corroboration -> MODERATE. Not inflation-suspect (real top-pharma relationships are registry-visible), but the 95% figure itself is unverifiable, so I avoid a clean PASS.

moderate_claims.claim_text: Desert Environmental developed two non-hazardous oilfield reclamation and solid waste disposal facilities on LandBridge's land, completed/operational in Q1 2024.
moderate_claims.M_check: epa_frs.query_facilities facility_name='Desert Environmental' (and broad 'Desert' / 'reclamation' / 'oilfield') in TX and NM, filtered to Delaware-Basin counties (Loving/Winkler/Reeves/Pecos/Ward/Andrews/Lea).
moderate_claims.M_value: 0 facilities registered under 'Desert Environmental' in TX or NM. Broad 'Desert' substring returns 68 TX noise hits, none matching a Desert Environmental waste/reclamation site in the relevant Permian counties. 'reclamation' (n=80) and 'oilfield' (n=208) Permian-county subsets show only unrelated operators (Battery Reclamation, Baker Hughes, etc.).
moderate_claims.interpretation: Affiliate-operated non-hazardous oilfield reclamation/solid-waste facilities claimed completed only in Q1 2024. EPA FRS does cover oilfield-waste/landfill sites, so a permitted facility would be expected to appear eventually, but FRS registration commonly lags a few months for newly-completed sites and the permitted-site name need not match the affiliate operating-entity name 'Desert Environmental LLC'. Two real reclamation facilities (Pecos/Reeves) do exist in the right basin under other names. Treated as a ceiling-vs-shown timing gap on a freshly-operational affiliate facility, not a benign-explanation-free absence -> MODERATE, not SEVERE.
